entries.code:
require "net/http"
begin
  uri = URI("https://example.com/")
  response = Net::HTTP.start(uri.hostname, uri.port,
    use_ssl: true, open_timeout: 10, read_timeout: 10) do |http|
    http.get(uri.request_uri)
  end
  raise "HTTP #{response.code}" unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
  puts response.body
rescue StandardError => error
  abort error.message
end

entries.code:
<?php
$ch = curl_init("https://example.com/");
if ($ch === false) throw new RuntimeException("cURL init failed");
curl_setopt_array($ch, [CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true, CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 10]);
$body = curl_exec($ch);
if ($body === false) throw new RuntimeException(curl_error($ch));
$status = curl_getinfo($ch, CURLINFO_HTTP_CODE);
if ($status < 200 || $status >= 300) throw new RuntimeException("HTTP $status");
echo $body;

explanation.en: Use cURL, distinguish transfer failures from HTTP failure status.
explanation.zh: 使用 cURL，区分传输失败与 HTTP 失败状态。

limitations.en: cURL is an extension, not universally installed. 404/500 do not make curl_exec return false. Redirects are not followed here.
limitations.zh: cURL 是扩展，并非所有安装均可用。404/500 不会让 curl_exec 返回 false。此例不跟随重定向。

prerequisites.en: PHP 8.x with cURL extension and working TLS trust configuration.
prerequisites.zh: PHP 8.x，需 cURL 扩展及可用的 TLS 信任配置。

prerequisites.zh: Swift 与 Foundation。HTTP 示例面向提供异步 URLSession 的 Apple SDK：iOS 15+、macOS 12+ 等。Foundation API 不属于 Swift 语言核心。未访问 Mac，未执行 Swift 示例。

explanation.en: Read UTF-8 with Foundation NSString and bridge to Swift String.
explanation.zh: 通过 Foundation NSString 读取 UTF-8，再桥接为 Swift String。

limitations.en: Whole-file read; try propagates failure, or wrap in do/catch. NSString is chosen to match the verified Foundation signature exactly.
limitations.zh: 整文件读取；try 传播失败，也可包装 do/catch。使用 NSString 以精确对应已核实的 Foundation 签名。

explanation.en: Write a UTF-8 file using Foundation, requesting auxiliary-file replacement.
explanation.zh: 使用 Foundation 写入 UTF-8，并请求通过辅助文件替换。

limitations.en: Only file URLs; parent directory and permissions matter. Atomic option is ignored for destinations that cannot support it.
limitations.zh: 仅支持文件 URL；需考虑父目录和权限。不支持原子操作的目标会忽略该选项。

explanation.en: Codable models work with Foundation JSONDecoder and JSONEncoder.
explanation.zh: Codable 模型配合 Foundation JSONDecoder 与 JSONEncoder 使用。

limitations.en: Codable is a protocol facility; actual JSON encoding/decoding here is Foundation. try propagates schema and encoding failures.
limitations.zh: Codable 是协议机制；此处实际 JSON 编解码由 Foundation 提供。try 传播结构不匹配及编码失败。

explanation.en: Foundation URLSession returns data and response; inspect status independently from thrown transport errors.
explanation.zh: Foundation URLSession 返回数据和响应；HTTP 状态检查独立于传输错误。

limitations.en: Apple-platform example, not a claim of Linux parity. Entire response buffered; production code needs explicit timeout/cancellation and response-encoding policy.
limitations.zh: 这是 Apple 平台示例，不宣称 Linux 完全一致。整响应进入内存；生产代码需明确超时、取消及响应编码策略。

sourceAccessNotes: Apple .md endpoints read directly with cloud urllib because web extractor returned JavaScript shell; canonical URLs retained.
Kotlin full-site TOC not extracted; verified subset documented transparently.
GitHub REST directory listing returned HTTP 403; no bypass attempted.
All examples are original illustrative snippets, not copied official sample programs.

limitations.zh: 整文件载入内存；ReadFile 本身不验证文本编码。

explanation.zh: 使用外部同步 HTTP 客户端，并要求成功状态码。

dependencies.en: Cargo: reqwest = { version = "0.13", features = ["blocking"] }; inspected docs 0.13.5. Not std.
dependencies.zh: Cargo：reqwest = { version = "0.13", features = ["blocking"] }；查阅版本 0.13.5。不属于 std。

limitations.en: Do not call blocking API inside an async runtime. Native targets only; text decoding may replace malformed sequences. error_for_status handles 4xx/5xx; this explicit check rejects every non-2xx.

limitations.en: std::string does not validate UTF-8. Invalid input remains invalid; strict validation needs additional logic/library. Entire file retained in memory.
limitations.zh: std::string 不验证 UTF-8；无效输入仍无效，严格验证需额外逻辑或库。整文件留在内存。

explanation.zh: 写入调用方提供的 UTF-8 字节，并显式关闭以观察关闭错误。

limitations.en: Assumes valid UTF-8; no transcoding. Overwrites existing content, not atomically. Setting exception mask also detects prior open failure.
limitations.zh: 假设有效 UTF-8，不转码。非原子地覆盖既有内容。设置异常掩码也检测此前的打开失败。

explanation.zh: 使用第三方 nlohmann/json 解析并序列化。

dependencies.en: Install nlohmann/json; include <nlohmann/json.hpp> and <string>. Header-only integration. Not standard library.
dependencies.zh: 安装 nlohmann/json；包含 <nlohmann/json.hpp>、<string>；可用纯头文件集成。不是标准库。

limitations.en: Catch nlohmann::json::exception; malformed JSON or UTF-8 can throw. Original whitespace and key order are not preserved.
limitations.zh: 捕获 nlohmann::json::exception；无效 JSON 或 UTF-8 可抛异常。不保留原空白与键顺序。

explanation.en: Call third-party libcurl C API from C++; distinguish transport result from HTTP status.
explanation.zh: 在 C++ 调用第三方 libcurl C API；区分传输结果和 HTTP 状态。

dependencies.en: Install libcurl development headers/library with HTTPS support and CA trust; link libcurl (often -lcurl). Not standard library.
dependencies.zh: 安装支持 HTTPS 的 libcurl 开发头文件/库及 CA 信任配置；链接 libcurl（通常 -lcurl）。不是标准库。

limitations.en: Body goes to stdout. Redirects are not followed, so 3xx fails. Configure a bounded write callback to retain response; initialize globally at application scope in larger programs.
limitations.zh: 响应体输出到 stdout。不跟随重定向，3xx 失败。保存响应需配置有大小限制的写回调；大型程序应在应用级全局初始化。
